name: digitalus.github.io
description: Personal website for Digitalus the developer…

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:css:min && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css:min: cleancss -o css/styles.css src/css/styles.css && cleancss -o apps/calc/style.css src/apps/calc/style.css && cleancss -o apps/frogger/style.css src/apps/frogger/style.css && cleancss -o apps/snake/style.css src/apps/snake/style.css
scripts.build:js: terser src/apps/calc/script.js -c -m -o apps/calc/script.js && terser src/apps/frogger/script.js -c -m -o apps/frogger/script.js && terser src/apps/snake/script.js -c -m -o apps/snake/script.js
